answer: The admission bond is time locked for 13 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in dawn, expire in dune, and hollow lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 96 aliases therefore needs 103 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4166 identities would post 3170 proofs and burn roughly 5 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
